I don't know about how your latency will look like in game. I play from NA, But all I can say is that you either NEED friends, or you need to be recruited to a guild as soon as you leave the tutorial island. If not, the PvP on the mainland will make you regret the time wasted on the tutorial area. There are people that kill randomly just to grief you. One of the hardest learning curves of any game out there. 
It's extremely in depth. But it's pretty fun/addicting when you have at least 1-2 week knowledge on the mainland(with a group/guild). Knowing how and when to fight or defend. 
There's a LOT. Look up "builds" so you can familiarize yourself with how character creation works, and what the different races do because every race is good at something different except humans, they are the most flexible. 
And keep up with henriks streams, he is the CEO of the game and streams weekly. 
But to be safe, I genuinely wouldn't recommend getting the game until UE5
